title: Xi Pitches AI Vision as Silicon Valley Leaders Tap Brakes
description:
“Bloomberg: The China Show” is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - The China Show opens
00:03:13 - AI leaders back slower development over safety concerns
00:06:53 - Artificial Analysis' Micah Hill-Smith on the need for stronger AI safeguards
00:14:36 - Triada Capital's Monica Hsiao on why US inflation remains sticky
00:26:30 - Triada Capital's Monica Hsiao on what to expect from the Fed and BOJ this week
00:29:49 - Chinese chip stocks withstand pressure from broader Asia selloff
00:35:02 - Xi resets ties with Modi on first India visit in seven years
00:39:29 - Z.AI seeks stock and bond sale to fund AI development
00:48:23 - OpenAI delays IPO to focus on AI safety
00:57:13 - Goldman Sachs' Si Fu on why AI profits are shifting toward hardware
01:05:58 - Former New York Fed President Bill Dudley on why he expects more rate hikes after September
01:11:56 - Chevron's Balaji Krishnamurthy on why LNG prices will remain elevated near term
01:16:30 - AI infrastructure spending seen cushioning chip selloff
01:19:12 - Why Z.AI's latest fundraising is unlikely to be its last
